product.name: meow-starter
product.goal: Provide a lightweight, composable, desktop-first foundation for AI-era applications.
nonGoals: Do not make cloud sync, Agent services, or provider credentials part of the default path.
Do not claim signed delivery, hosted updates, store submission, deployed Web hosting, or real-device validation without separate evidence.

web: Skip desktop-only modules and use IndexedDB for local Todo data.
mobile: Skip desktop-only modules while retaining responsive UI and native SQL where supported.

evolution.additive: Add fields only in a schema version that the checker explicitly understands.
evolution.breaking: Document a migration when removing or renaming a module, data format, or compatibility promise.
